whyItMatters: Marshal.load deserializes ruby objects from bytes, so hostile input can trigger gadget execution during decoding.
actions: Replace Marshal.load with JSON parsing for any bytes that cross a trust boundary.
If object graphs must persist, authenticate the bytes (MAC/signature) and verify before decoding.
Re-run the scan and confirm no Marshal.load call remains reachable from untrusted bytes.
verification: Rescan shows no Marshal.load reachable from untrusted bytes, and hostile payloads decode to inert data or fail closed.
